smoke.description: Cheapest wiring check: 1 iteration, no parallelism, 10-min cap. Pass --model/--task.

fast-refresh.description: Re-measure a fast API model: 5 iterations, concurrency 2, 10-min cap.

slow-model.description: Slow free-tier/CLI model: no retries, 25-min cap, cache busted, concurrency 2.

agy-quota.description: Agy per-model subscription window: serial, 5 iterations, default timeouts.

builtins-only.description: Core task set only: mounts no plugins ([] = builtins only). Compose with --iterations etc.

astra-devin.description: Astra extra high vs SWE-2 High: 3 fresh iterations, concurrency 4, 25-min cap, no retries.

claude-family.description: The Claude family at the registry default effort: Fable 5.2, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5, on the 10 ready headline tasks (seat-pricing is held back until its contrast check passes review). 3 iterations, concurrency 2, 45-min per-call cap (a 128,000-token answer takes about 24 min), 1 retry, $60 cap per model.

claude-effort.description: Claude effort variants on the 10 ready headline tasks (seat-pricing held back): Haiku 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 at low and xhigh, Opus 5.5 at low and high, Fable 5.2 at low. 3 iterations, concurrency 2, 45-min per-call cap, 1 retry, $30 cap per model.

claude-smoke.description: Claude Haiku 5.5 on the 7 smoke tasks (harness wiring checks, never ranked). 3 iterations, $2 cap per model.
